newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba says property unit manager detained.
newsitem.headline: Veba says property unit manager detained.

text.p: German utility Veba AG said on Wednesday that prosecutors had started an investigation into alleged irregularities at its property unit Veba Immobilien and had detained a leading employee.
In a brief statement, Veba said its own auditors were also probing the alleged offences, having themselves initiated the probe and passed on information to the public prosecutors office in Bochum.
No details were given on the allegations, other than that they centred on "disloyalty."
"Veba AG and the Bochum public prosecutors' office are working closely together to completely clear up the incident," the utility said.
It was too early to determine either the extent of the damage or the possible consequences for Veba staff.
